topics.name: CSM Foundational Data Model
topics.description: Business models (B2B, B2C, B2B2C, B2B2E), product models, install base management, and contracts/entitlements.

introduction.overview: The CSM foundational data model defines how customer data is structured in ServiceNow. It encompasses business models that determine customer relationships, product catalogs, install base tracking, and service entitlements.
introduction.whyItMatters: This domain represents 27% of the CIS-CSM exam. Questions cover business model selection (B2B vs B2C), customer and consumer tables, product model management, install base configuration, and entitlement validation.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand the four business models (B2B, B2C, B2B2C, B2B2E) and when to use each. Know the difference between customer_contact and consumer tables. Master product model hierarchy, install base items, and how entitlements control service access.
introduction.examTips: B2B uses Accounts and Contacts; B2C uses Consumers. Product models define what you sell; install base tracks what customers own. Entitlements determine what services a customer can access and under what conditions.

keyConcepts: B2B, B2C, B2B2C, B2B2E business models

topics.name: CSM Configuration
topics.description: CSM setup in ServiceNow, routing and assignment, case types, and communication channels.

introduction.overview: CSM Configuration covers the technical setup of Customer Service Management in ServiceNow, including routing strategies, case type definitions, and omnichannel communication options.
introduction.whyItMatters: This is the largest domain at 38% of the exam. Expect questions on CSM plugins, Guided Setup, routing and assignment rules, case types, and channel configuration (email, chat, phone, portal).
introduction.keyConcepts: Master CSM Guided Setup tasks, understand routing options (assignment rules, data lookup, Advanced Work Assignment), case type configuration, and channel management for omnichannel support.
introduction.examTips: Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) provides intelligent routing based on agent skills and availability. Case types control case behavior and required fields. Know the difference between manual and automatic routing.

topics.name: Case Management
topics.description: Case state flows, major issue management, case digests, CSM workspace, case actions, tasks, and escalations.

introduction.overview: Case Management is the core of CSM, covering the complete lifecycle of customer cases from creation through resolution. It includes handling major issues that affect multiple customers, task management, and escalation procedures.
introduction.whyItMatters: Case Management accounts for 17% of the exam. Questions focus on case states, major issue management, parent-child case relationships, case tasks, escalations, and resolution workflows.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand case state transitions, major case management for widespread issues, case summaries and digests, case tasks and their lifecycle, and when to use escalations versus other mechanisms.
introduction.examTips: Cases follow a specific state flow. Major cases can have child cases attached. Case tasks break down work into manageable pieces. Know the difference between escalation and reassignment.

topics.name: Workspace, Portals & Analytics
topics.description: CSM Workspace, customer portals, Service Catalog, special handling notes, SLAs, targeted communications, and reporting.

introduction.overview: This domain covers the agent and customer experience in CSM, including the CSM Configurable Workspace for agents, customer-facing portals, service catalog items, and analytics/reporting capabilities.
introduction.whyItMatters: This domain is 8% of the exam. Questions cover CSM Workspace components, portal configuration, Service Catalog case creation, special handling notes, SLA management, targeted communications, and dashboard configuration.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand the CSM Configurable Workspace layout and components. Know how to configure customer portals for self-service. Master special handling notes for VIP customers, SLA configuration, and targeted communications for proactive outreach.
introduction.examTips: Special handling notes alert agents to important customer information. Targeted communications allow proactive outreach to affected customers. Know the difference between Performance Analytics dashboards and standard reports.

topics.name: Best Practices & Knowledge Management
topics.description: ServiceNow architecture best practices, end-to-end processes, project scope, knowledge functionality, AQI, and knowledge blocks.

introduction.overview: This domain covers implementation best practices and Knowledge Management features that support case resolution. It includes architectural considerations, scoping projects correctly, and leveraging knowledge articles effectively.
introduction.whyItMatters: Best Practices and Knowledge Management represent 10% of the exam. Questions cover CSM architecture recommendations, end-to-end process design, project scoping, Article Quality Index (AQI), knowledge blocks, and search optimization.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand CSM implementation best practices including the 'Better Together' principle of integrating CSM with other ServiceNow applications. Master Knowledge Management features including AQI scoring, knowledge blocks for reusable content, and contextual search.
introduction.examTips: The 'Better Together' principle emphasizes CSM integration with ITSM, ITOM, and other ServiceNow apps. AQI measures article quality based on feedback and usage. Knowledge blocks allow content reuse across articles.
